description: Search IMDb for movies and TV shows. Can search by title or browse curated charts (Top 250 Movies, Top 250 TV, Most Popular Movies, Most Popular TV). Returns ratings, year, cast, and IMDb links.

chart.description: IMDb chart: top (Top 250 Movies), toptv (Top 250 TV), moviemeter (Most Popular Movies), tvmeter (Most Popular TV)

query.description: Movie or TV show title to search (e.g. "inception", "breaking bad")

name: search_imdb
